// CASE dart_helper_other_name expect=pass
Future<List<R>> runBounded<T, R>(
  List<T> items,
  int width,
  Future<R> Function(T item) operation,
) async {
  final results = <R>[];
  for (var offset = 0; offset < items.length; offset += width) {
    final group = items.skip(offset).take(width);
    results.addAll(await Future.wait(group.map(operation)));
  }
  return results;
}

// CASE dart_other_name_width_one expect=fire
Future<void> otherNameOne(List<int> items, Future<void> Function(int) save) async {
  await runBounded(items, 1, save);
}
